elements.text: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: First assess and manage airway, breathing, circulation and level of consciousness 16.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Identify all injuries and look for cause, undress patient and assess front and back. If injured, use log-roll to turn. Then cover and keep warm.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: If seizures 20, if injuries 30, if burns 31.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: If sudden decreased consciousness and any of: generalised itch/rash, face/tongue swelling, wheeze, difficulty breathing, abdominal pain, vomiting or exposure to possible allergen1, check for anaphylaxis 28.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Check glucose, temperature and pupils:

elements.text: Glucose

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Temperature

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Pupils

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: < 3 (< 4 if diabetes) or unable to measure

elements.text: Pinpoint

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Both equally dilated

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Unequal or

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: respond poorly to light

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Give fluids:

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Remove cold/ wet clothing and cover with warm blankets.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Give ceftriaxone6 2g IM for possible meningitis. Avoid injecting > 1g IM at one injection site.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Illegal

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Excessive secretions or muscle twitching

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Raise head by 30 degrees.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: If SBP < 80, pulse ≥ 100, respiratory rate > 30, weakness, shock likely. Give sodium chloride 0.9% 20mL/kg bolus and repeat until systolic BP > 80.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: drug use and/or

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Stimulant or other drug overdose likely

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Give dextrose 10%2 5mL/ kg IV. If known alcohol user, give thiamine 200mg IM before dextrose.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: If injured, keep body straight and tilt to raise head (avoid bending spine).

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: respiratory rate < 12

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Warm IV fluids to 40°C (avoid cold fluids).

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: If patient was in malaria area in past 3 months, manage 39.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Poisoning likely 27.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Also give sodium chloride 0.9% 15-20mL/kg 4 IV over the first hour, then 10mL/kg/ hour thereafter.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: If no response or temperature ≤ 32°C, also use a warming device.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: If temperature > 40°C:

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Discuss urgently with referral centre.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Remove clothing.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Recheck glucose after 15 minutes: if still < 3, give further dextrose 10%2 2mL/kg IV.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Use fan and water spray to cool patient.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: If known kidney/heart disease, discuss fluid volume with doctor.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Apply ice-packs to axillae, groin and neck.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Then give dextrose 5%3 or 10% 1L IV 6 hourly.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Stop if breathing worsens.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: If known diabetes and referral delay > 2 hours, discuss with referral centre before giving short-acting insulin 0.1units/ kg IM5. Insulin may cause low potassium and heart dysrhythmia; avoid if unable to monitor serum electrolytes.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Refer urgently.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: While awaiting transport:

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: Check BP, pulse, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation and GCS every 15 minutes. Insert urinary catheter.

elements.section: Give urgent attention to the patient with decreased consciousness:
elements.text: If BP < 90/60, pulse > 100 or < 50, respiratory rate > 20 or < 9, oxygen saturation < 94% or drop in GCS, reassess and manage airway, breathing, circulation and level of consciousness 16.
DECREASED CONSCIOUSNESS

1Common allergens include medication, food or insect bite/sting within the past few hours. 2If dextrose 10% unavailable: mix 1 part dextrose 50% to 4 parts water for injection to make dextrose 10% solution. 3If dextrose 5% not available: add 10mL dextrose 50% to each 100mL of sodium chloride 0.9%. 4Avoid giving > 50mL/kg in the first 4 hours. 5Avoid using insulin needle, use 22-25 gauge needle. 6If severe penicillin allergy (previous anaphylaxis, urticaria or angioedema), discuss with doctor.
